policy: Early-warning only. Each working group, consultation, pilot, standard draft, and legislative proposal must retain its own legal status. Do not infer enacted law, market date, or type approval from a research demonstration.

initiatives.title: UNECE GRPE / IWG EVE – GTR 21/22/25
initiatives.assessment: GTR 21/22/25 revisions; distinguish draft/GRPE recommendations from WP29 approval and regional incorporation

initiatives.title: UNECE GRVA IWG CS/OTA – R155/R156 interpretation and ToR
initiatives.assessment: Track R155/R156 interpretation, multi-stage approval, software identification and post-registration updates

initiatives.title: UNECE GRVA ADS/AI/AEBS/ESRI task forces
initiatives.assessment: Watch requirements for ADS data, fault monitoring, validation scenarios, AEBS false positives and safety incident handling

initiatives.title: EU Roadworthiness Package COM(2025)180 / 2025/0097(COD)
initiatives.assessment: Changes to PTI, inspection data and possible shared service and vehicle history chains; proposals not yet binding

initiatives.title: Japan MLIT OBD-kensa 8th monitoring meeting
initiatives.assessment: Follow meeting outcomes on operational field problems, scan tools and inspection scope; date is event not new law

initiatives.title: Japan MLIT OBD inspection monitoring materials
initiatives.assessment: Inspect documented field issues and solutions; identify technical requirements only when legal notice confirms

initiatives.title: China MEE draft new-vehicle emissions compliance supervision
initiatives.assessment: Track proposed conformity supervision across production and field; do not confuse with final China 7

initiatives.title: China HJ 1477-2026 Light-Duty RDE methods
initiatives.assessment: Cross-check any China 7 proposal against already-effective RDE test method; verify exact application to homologation

initiatives.title: California HD Omnibus/LCFS/Emergency vehicle rulemaking
initiatives.assessment: Separate heavy-duty engine/vehicle from LD rules, track OAL and Federal/EPA differences

initiatives.title: H2020 DIAS – Smart Adaptive Remote Diagnostic Antitampering Systems
initiatives.assessment: Anomaly and tamper detection on vehicle, prototype ECU/CCU and cloud demonstration; evidence of engineering feasibility only

initiatives.title: China pilot on intelligent and connected vehicle access (GRVA-24-21)
initiatives.assessment: Track link to national MIIT/road operation rules; pilot presentation not itself legally binding

initiatives.title: UNECE GRVA/2026/5 Interpretation Document UN R156
initiatives.assessment: Track guidance interpretation separately from amendments to legally enforceable UN R156

initiatives.title: ISO/AWI 17978-4 SOVD Remote Access
initiatives.assessment: Prepare E2E remote access and diagnostics architecture; separate from mandatory OBD port requirements

initiatives.title: GRVA/2026/28-30 – Vorschlaege zu UN R155 und R156
initiatives.assessment: Pruefen, welche Aenderungen in UN R155/R156 aus /28,/29,/30 sowie GRVA-26-11/12 beschlossen und national angewandt werden; keine vorgezogene Rechtswirkung

initiatives.title: MEE/SAMR Leitlinie zur Reform der Emissionspruefstellen und KI-Anomalieerkennung
initiatives.assessment: MEE/SAMR Leitlinien fuer Emissionspruefstellen: qualifizierte Messmittel und Software, verbesserte Ueberwachung sowie Anomalieerkennung; nicht mit einer pauschalen fahrzeugseitigen OBD-KI-Pflicht verwechseln
